mapping_effect: New local candidate registry under the unresolved source identity, derived from exact linked source meanings; not a recovered source registry or operational admission.

obligations.statement: A Solana public key may authorize only through a current scoped binding and must never be treated as the Knowledge Identity.
Every account used by the transition must belong to the exact admitted aggregate derivation domain for the artifact version and program realization.
A successful first grant changes owner set {A} to {A, B} and preserves A's existing membership.
On-chain state may contain only the recipient envelope commitment and optional locator, never plaintext, the content key, envelope plaintext, or a recipient private key.
Submitting or signing a grant instruction does not establish a Co-Ownership Grant; only the exact successful post-state and bounded evidence can support that claim.
B's membership, B's envelope commitment, revision increment, and replay consumption must commit together, or none may commit.
One domain-separated grant operation identity may succeed at most once for the exact program, artifact, revision, grantor, recipient, and instruction kind.
Every Solana co-ownership claim must name program realization, execution environment, commitment level, instruction inputs, and pre/post state.

The first Solana grant contains no knowledge price, escrow, seller payout, royalty, treasury consideration, barter, or token transfer; network fees and rent remain separately visible infrastructure costs.
A Solana realization claim must bind exact ontology, source, build, program identifier, loader, upgrade posture, environment, and fixture or deployment identity.
The instruction must resolve the immutable propagation policy and exact expected pre-state revision before evaluating authority or mutation.
Every rejected authorization, stale binding, malformed account, replay, or invalid envelope commitment must preserve all protected protocol state.
